title: gynura rubens
intro: Gynura rubens, commonly known as the red spinach or dragon's blood, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a tropical plant native to Southeast Asia, traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Gynura rubens include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
